item.title: $125 million Pleasant Street project set to finish by summer’s end
item.description: The $125 million Reimagine Pleasant Street project in Noblesville, Indiana, is on track to be completed by the end of the summer, featuring new bridges, roundabouts, trails, and improved pedestrian and bike access.

item.title: 3 dead, 3 critically injured in Rhode Island hockey arena shooting
item.description: Three people, including the suspect, were fatally shot during a Rhode Island youth hockey game Monday, and three others were hospitalized in critical condition. Authorities suggested the incident was a targeted event possibly related to a family dispute.

item.title: Hailey Buzbee’s former employer raises money for her family
item.description: The community of Fortville, Indiana came together to raise money for the Buzbee family after the tragic death of their granddaughter, Hailey, who had worked at The Kitchen on Main restaurant and saved all of her money for college.

item.title: WISH-TV legal expert talks about federal charges for suspect in Hailey Buzbee case
item.description: Tyler Thomas faces federal charges of travel and interstate commerce to engage in unlawful sexual contact with a child and child exploitation in the case of 17-year-old Hailey Buzbee, after state-level charges were dropped. WISH-TV legal expert Zach Myers talks about the case.

item.title: Mari Evans: Indianapolis icon of Black Arts Movement remembered
item.description: Mari Evans, an African American poet, writer, television host and professor, was a champion of the Black arts movement in Indianapolis and is honored with a mural at the corner of Mass Avenue and Michigan Street.

item.title: Marching toward record high potential Wednesday, stronger storm risk Thursday | Feb. 16, 2026
item.description: After a mild Monday, expect temperatures to continue to rise with Wednesday potentially reaching record highs for the day and Thursday bringing a risk of strong to severe storms.

item.title: Indiana tackles penny-rounding policies amid national shortage
item.description: Indiana lawmakers are crafting statewide penny-rounding policies to address the nationwide shortage of pennies, but admit the bill needs more work and could result in state revenue losses.

item.title: Luxury steamer that sank in 1872 found in Lake Michigan after 60-year search
item.description: MADISON, Wis. (AP) — Searchers have discovered the wreck of a luxury steamer that sank in a Lake Michigan gale in the late 19th century, completing a quest that began almost 60 years ago. item.title: Grant County crash leaves 3 young adults dead and 1 injured
item.description: Three people were killed and one was injured in a crash in Grant County, Indiana, when a car driven by Alexander McGuin veered off the road and struck a tree, with police suspecting alcohol, narcotics, and speed may have been factors.

item.title: Beech Grove police officer killed, another injured in shooting; suspect in custody
item.description: A 33-year-old Beech Grove police officer was shot and killed Monday while responding to a disturbance in an apartment, and another officer was injured, prompting a search for the suspect, Kenneth Terrell Johnson, who is still at large.
